instruction: Write an XDP program that records per-flow metrics (packets, bytes, last_seen timestamp) in a BPF LRU hash map for all IPv4 TCP and UDP flows. Return XDP_PASS for all traffic.
requirements: Define BPF LRU hash map 'flow_metrics' with key 5-tuple and value struct flow_stats
Update packet and byte count atomically or with map value pointer
Strictly validate Ethernet, IPv4, and transport layer boundaries

tests.name: test_tcp_flow_pass
tests.description: TCP packet should record flow telemetry and pass

tests.name: test_udp_flow_pass
tests.description: UDP packet should record flow telemetry and pass

tests.name: test_icmp_pass
tests.description: ICMP packet should pass unaffected without flow update

tests.name: test_arp_pass
tests.description: Non-IP ARP packet should pass unaffected
